description: This file contains implementation of prepack functions for quantized embedding bag weights in PyTorch, including support for different quantization schemes (8-bit, 4-bit, 2-bit), and functions for packing and quantizing weight tensors with optional row-wise min/max parameters. It also registers these functions with the PyTorch library system.

classes.name: QEmbeddingPackWeights
classes.description: A class providing a static method to run the prepack function for embedding weights.

methods.name: PackedEmbeddingBagWeight::prepack
methods.description: Prepack function for quantized embedding bag weights, supporting different quantization schemes and storing scale and bias per row.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack
methods.description: Function to pack a float or half tensor into a quantized byte format with optional row-wise min/max.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack_with_rowwise_min_max
methods.description: Pack tensor with explicit row-wise min/max for quantization.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack_meta
methods.description: Generate metadata tensor for byte prepacked embedding weights.

methods.name: _qembeddingbag_nbit_prepack_helper
methods.description: Helper function for packing 2-bit or 4-bit quantized embedding weights, supporting optional row-wise min/max and optimized qparams.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_4bit_prepack_with_rowwise_min_max
methods.description: Pack tensor into 4-bit quantized format with explicit row-wise min/max.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_2bit_prepack_with_rowwise_min_max
methods.description: Pack tensor into 2-bit quantized format with explicit row-wise min/max.
